text_en: Hear what the Lord says: Rise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice.
text_cn: 惟愿你们倾听上主所说的话：“起来，在诸山面前进行诉讼，使诸丘陵能听见你的声音！”

text_en: Hear, you mountains, the controversy of the Lord , and you enduring foundations of the earth; for the Lord has a controversy with his people, and he will contend with Israel.
text_cn: 诸山！请听上主的申诉；大地的基础，侧耳聆听罢！因为上主与他的人民有所争讼，与以色列有所争辩：

text_en: “O my people, what have I done to you? In what have I wearied you? Answer me!
text_cn: “我的人民！我对你做了什么？我在什么事上叫你讨厌？请你答复我！

text_en: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and redeemed you from the house of slavery; and I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
text_cn: 难道是因为我由埃及地领了你上来，从奴隶之家赎了你回来，在你面前委派了梅瑟、亚郎和米黎盎？

text_en: O my people, remember now what King Balak of Moab devised, what Balaam son of Beor answered him, and what happened from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the saving acts of the Lord . ”
text_cn: 我的人民，请你记忆摩阿布王巴拉克图谋过什么事，贝敖尔的儿子巴郎答应了他什么；再记忆从史廷到基耳加耳发生过什么事，好使你明了上主的仁慈作为。”

text_en: “With what shall I come before the Lord , and bow myself before God on high? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?
text_cn: “我要到上主那里，叩拜至高者天主，应进献什么？应进献全燔祭，还是应进献一岁的牛犊？

text_en: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of rams, with ten thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my transgression, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul? ”
text_cn: 上主岂喜悦万千的公羊，或万道河流的油？为了我的过犯，我应否献上我的长子？为了我灵魂的罪恶，我应否献上我亲生的儿子？”

text_en: He has told you, O mortal, what is good; and what does the Lord require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?
text_cn: 人啊！已通知了你，什么是善，上主要求于你的是什么：无非就是履行正义，爱好慈善，虚心与你的天主来往。

text_en: The voice of the Lord cries to the city (it is sound wisdom to fear your name): Hear, O tribe and assembly of the city!
text_cn: 听，上主向城邑的呼声：我必拯救敬畏我名的人。支派和城市的会众，静听：

text_en: Can I forget the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is accursed?
text_cn: 我岂能忘掉恶人家中的不义之财，和那可诅咒的小“厄法”？

text_en: Can I tolerate wicked scales and a bag of dishonest weights?
text_cn: 我岂能把用欺骗的天秤和囊中有假法码的人视为清廉？

text_en: Your wealthy are full of violence; your inhabitants speak lies, with tongues of deceit in their mouths.
text_cn: 城中的富人充满了强暴，其中的居民好说谎话，满口欺诈；

text_en: Therefore I have begun to strike you down, making you desolate because of your sins.
text_cn: 因此，我才开始打击你，为了你的罪恶使你荒凉。

text_en: You shall eat, but not be satisfied, and there shall be a gnawing hunger within you; you shall put away, but not save, and what you save, I will hand over to the sword.
text_cn: 你要吃，却吃不饱，腹中常感到空虚；你纵然能把宝藏搬走，却不能保全；即使你能保全，我也必要付之于刀剑。

text_en: You shall sow, but not reap; you shall tread olives, but not anoint yourselves with oil; you shall tread grapes, but not drink wine.
text_cn: 你要播种，却得不到收获；你要榨橄榄油，却得不到油抹身；你要榨葡萄酒，却得不到酒喝。

text_en: For you have kept the statutes of Omri and all the works of the house of Ahab, and you have followed their counsels. Therefore I will make you a desolation, and your inhabitants an object of hissing; so you shall bear the scorn of my people.
text_cn: 因为你遵守了敖默黎的法令，保存了阿哈布家的一切作风，遵循了他们的主张； 因此，我必要使你荒凉，使你的居民成为笑柄；你必要承担异民的侮辱。
